Name: Pastel Floral Tools
Author: swiftishere1
Description:
[center]﻿Like many people, I like to play Stardew Valley with a lot of map edits and recolors. But that always made the tools, especially gold and iridium, feel out of place to me. So I finally sat down and recolored them, and in the process gave them vines and flowers that bloom as you upgrade them! At the final stage of upgrading, your tools become one with the flowers that bloom on them.

I've not tested this extensively, but the mod should be compatible with mods that edit other parts of the tools tilesheet. Please do let me know if issues or conflicts arise![/center][b][size=3]
[b][size=3]1.4.0[/size][/b][/size][/b][size=3][size=3]: A bunch of stuff!
- Added the new Iridium Scythe and Advanced Iridium Rod to the recolors.
- You can now separately toggle the base color and flower colors on and off. So you could have no vines at all and just the pastel tools, if you wanted.
[size=3][size=3]- By popular request, I have FINALLY added an option for iridium tools to keep the flowers and vines. Currently these are just the same as the gold flowers. I may revisit the iridium recolors in the future, we'll see. [/size][/size]The iridium tools are still controlled via a separate config to the rest of the sets, so you're still able to keep the flowers on everything but the iridium, or turn them off entirely to use a different set of iridium tool reskins. The world is your oyster.
- More versions of the animal tools! In addition to the old iridium tools, there's also versions that match the steel and gold tools. These also have flowers now.
- Added two versions of the Scepter of Return.

I've added a picture showcasing all of the new config options to the mod images on Nexus.
[/size][/size][b][size=3][b][size=3]
1.3.0[/size][/b][/size][/b][size=3][size=3]: [/size][/size][size=3][size=3]At long last, scythes and fishing rods have been added!
[/size][/size][b][size=3][b][size=3]
1.2.1[/size][/b][/size][/b][size=3][size=3]:[/size][/size][size=3][size=3] Per request, you can now toggle the iridium tools on or off via the "ReplaceIridium" option in the config.json. Defaults to True.[/size][/size][b][size=3]

1.2.0[/size][/b][size=3]: Courtesy of the very kind elesaHonu, we now have recolored sprites for the shears and milk pail! These match the iridium tools best, but look nice with every set. They can be enabled or disabled via the "EleseaFlowers" setting in the config.json.[/size][b][size=3]

1.1.0[/size][/b][size=3]: Added FlowersOnly config, which will only apply the vines and flowers without the base tool recolors. Compatible with other mods that recolor tools as well as the vanilla tool colors.
[/size][size=2]Run game once to generate config.json
[/size]Set FlowersOnly: "True" (will only use vines and flowers), "False" (will apply the full recolor), default False
